_about: TRACKED seed: curated business-noun -> table aliases for source 2 (homzhub). Copied into the per-source artifact veda_entity_aliases.json by the L5 stage ingestion/entity_alias_seeder.py, which is why this file — unlike the artifact — is in source control. _why_tracked: The artifact itself lives under veda_core/data/, which .gitignore excludes as 'derived ingestion artifacts, regenerated every ingest'. This file is NOT derived — it is hand-curated evidence — and when it lived only as a gitignored artifact the 2026-09-22 reingest silently deleted it (veda_entity_aliases.json.bak-20260922-140816 is the corpse). With the glossary gone, 'property' had no table to ground to, so the bare-count anchor gate refused 'how many properties are there' and the qualifier gate offered 'property' as a missing VALUE — the ['property'] clarify that hit 5 of the 20 question.txt questions on 2026-09-23.
